I'll mark satisfied with evidence [2], plus maybe 0. But index 0 is assistant, untrusted-ish. I'll use [2].

Req2: status=completed, complete=true, route=bulk, tax & shipping nodes executed, join after. Tool result trace shows all four nodes completed. Order in trace: bulk, calc_shipping, calc_tax, join — join after both. Parallelism not directly provable but both executed before join; satisfied with [2].

Req3: amounts — [2].

Req4: reply explains bulk branch and amounts consistent — [0] and [2].
